audit_log.value: I run a small pet sitting and dog walking business and need a simple monthly service agreement for a repeat client. I do weekday dog walks, occasional weekend visits, medication reminders, feeding, litter box cleanup, and photo updates. I want something clear that explains what services are included, how extra visits are approved, payment due dates, cancellation notice, home access instructions, pet emergency consent, responsibility for damages caused by pets, and a simple way for both sides to review and sign.

effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
